concerns.text: FR-001 (Dataset parsing) and SC-001 (Access Control measurement) lack a dedicated task for the actual data fetching and parsing logic implementation. T006 implements the loader skeleton, but no task explicitly covers the logic to fetch the GateMem dataset from HuggingFace and parse the JSONL into the required structure (outcome, predictors, covariates, leak-target) as mandated by FR-001. T006b validates against a schema that T004 defines, but the data acquisition and parsing flow is incomplete.

FR-003 (Baseline execution) and SC-001 (Access Control comparison) are not fully covered. T017 implements baseline execution paths, but there is no task explicitly responsible for generating the 'Retrieval-only' and 'Long-Context' baseline results files (`data/processed/baseline_results.json`) with the specific metrics required for the Access Control comparison. T018 calculates the metric, but the baseline data generation step is missing a distinct task.

FR-004 (Calculate three core metrics) and SC-002/SC-005 (Utility/Forgetting measurement) are partially covered but lack a task for the 'Overall Task Success Rate' metric. T023, T024, T025 cover Utility, Forgetting, and False Positive/Negative rates, but FR-004 explicitly requires 'Overall Task Success Rate (net success including False Positives)' which is not mapped to a specific task (T028 aggregates, but the calculation logic for 'Overall Success' is missing).

FR-006 (Profile computational cost) and SC-003 (Cost measurement) are covered by T032-T035, but SC-003 requires measuring 'wall-clock inference time and peak CPU/RAM usage' for both configurations. T032 integrates profiling, T033/34 run pipelines, but there is no explicit task to 'Calculate percentage reduction' or 'Aggregate profiling data' into the final comparison format required by SC-003 before T036 (report generation). T035 exists but is marked [US3] and depends on T032-34; ensure T035 explicitly covers the aggregation logic for the final report.

FR-007 (Output failure cases) and SC-004 (Statistical significance) are covered by T029 and T036b, but T029 (sampling logic) and T042 (validation) do not explicitly cover the 'stratified by domain' logic for N > 50 as required by FR-007. T029 mentions 'stratified by domain', but the task description needs to ensure the implementation of the stratification logic is distinct from simple random sampling.

T006b and T008b/T026b contain duplicate logic descriptions regarding fallback mechanisms (LMM failure -> t-test/Wilcoxon). T008b and T026b both describe the same fallback logic for `src/utils/stats.py`. This creates redundancy and potential confusion in task execution. Consolidate into a single task or clearly distinguish the scope (e.g., T008b for general stats, T026b for US2 specific).
